
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/tcjiaan/p/20061618" title="发布于 2026-05-17 17:07">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">【EF Core】继承策略——TPH</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p>既然 EF Core 的设计理念是以面向对象的方式操作数据库，那么，继承问题是绕不过去的。然而大伙伴也知道，数据库是用表来存储数据记录的，表与表之间哪来的继承。很自然地，EF Core 必须在数据库与实体类之间做一些特殊处理，才能让存在继承关系的实体类与数据表之间的映射不被破坏。</p>
<p>EF Core 内置了三种应对策略：</p>
<p>1、TPH：全称&nbsp;Table Per Hierarchy。其特点是将整个继承链上的实体都存放在一个数据表中。假设有 X、Y 两实体，Y 继承 X，于是，两个实体都存到名为 T_abc 的表中。由于多个类型映射到一个表中，为了区分，EF Core 会向数据表添加一个额外的列，用于标识类型。默认用的是实体类的名称。</p>
<p>2、TPT：Table-Per-Type。从命名可以看出，每个类型对应一个表。假设 B 继承 A，那么，A 映射到 TA 表，B 映射到 TB 表。但，数据表只映射当前类所定义的成员，不包括从基类继承的成员。假如，A 类有 ID、X 两个属性，那么，TA 表就会映射 ID 和 X；B 类定义了 C 属性，映射时只把 C 属性映射到 TB 表，不会映射从 A 类继承的 ID 和 X 属性。</p>
<p>3、TPC：即&nbsp;Table-Per-Concrete-Type。它强调“具体类型”，其实它和 TPT 很像，都每个实体都映射一个表，但是，TPC 策略中，派生类会把从基类继承的成员也映射到表中。引沿上面举的例子，即 A 类会映射 ID 和 X 属性到 TA 表，而 B 类会映射 ID、X、C 属性到 TB 表。</p>
<p>咱们先来研究 TPH 策略。</p>
<p>我们举个例子，有两个类，它们存在继承关系。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 基类</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BaseType
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Bid { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 派生类</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DeriveType : BaseType
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span> SValue { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>EF Core 的公共约定类具备自动发现继承链的能力，前提是你得先把这些实体类添加到数据库模型中。因此，重写 DbContext 类的 OnModelCreating 方法时，代码可以这样写：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置基类实体</span>
modelBuilder.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Entity&lt;BaseType&gt;</span></strong>(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    ent.HasKey(x </span>=&gt; x.Bid);     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主键</span>
    ent.ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_zbzb</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置表名</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">});
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置派生类实体</span>
modelBuilder.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Entity&lt;DeriveType&gt;</span></strong>();</pre>
</div>
<p>在配置模型时，有些地方得注意：</p>
<p>A、TPH 只映射一个表，基类子类都存放一起，所以，只能在基类的配置中调用 ToTable 方法设置表名，在配置派生类时不要再映射表名了；</p>
<p>B、主键只能在基类的配置中设置，不能在派生类的配置中设置。如上面的例子，如果在配置 DeriveType 类上设置主键，比如这样。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 基类</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BaseType
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Bid { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 派生类</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DeriveType : BaseType
{
    </span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> Mid { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
</span></span></strong>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span> SValue { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">--------------------------------------------------
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置基类实体</span>
modelBuilder.Entity&lt;BaseType&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    ent.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_zbzb</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>);     <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 设置表名</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">});
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置派生类实体</span>
modelBuilder.Entity&lt;DeriveType&gt;(d =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
{
    d.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasKey(x </span></strong></span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">=&gt; x.Mid)</span></strong>;      <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主键</span>
});</pre>
</div>
<p>运行后，就会报以下错误：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>A key cannot be configured on <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">DeriveType</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> because it <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> a derived type. <br>The key must be configured on the root type <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">BaseType</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>. <br>If you did not intend <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">for</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">BaseType</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span> to be included <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> the model, <br>ensure that it <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> not referenced by a DbSet property on your context instance, <br>referenced <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> a configuration call to <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ModelBuilder</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">'</span>, or referenced <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">from</span> a navigation on a type that <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> included <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span> the model.</pre>
</div>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>上面例子，构建了以下数据库模型。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Model: 
  EntityType: BaseType
    Properties: 
      Bid (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) Required PK AfterSave:Throw ValueGenerated.OnAdd
      <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)"><strong><em>Discriminator</em></strong></span> (no field, </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>) Shadow Required AfterSave:Throw MaxLength(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    Keys: 
      Bid PK
  EntityType: DeriveType <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">Base: BaseType</span></strong>
    Properties: 
      SValue (</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span>) Required</pre>
</div>
<p>在 DeriveType 实体的模型信息中，Base: BaseType 表示它的基类是 BaseType。说明 EF Core 已经自动配置好继承关系。如果你想手动配置实体的继承关系，可以在配置派生类实体时调用 HasBaseType 方法。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>modelBuilder.Entity&lt;DeriveType&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">()
            .<em><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasBaseType</span></em></span><em><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">&lt;BaseType&gt;()</span></em>;</pre>
</div>
<p>调用 HasBaseType 方法所指的基类必须是 .NET 代码中确实存在继承关系的类。比如，如果 DeriveType 不是 BaseType 的派生类，那么，调用 HasBaseType 方法会报错。EF Core 会验证 .NET 类型是否存在继承关系。</p>
<p>我们还会发现，EF Core 为 BaseType 实体添加了一个叫&nbsp;Discriminator 的影子属性，它会被映射到数据表中的某一列。Discriminator 叫鉴别器，或叫判别器。作用是标识类型的——区分这条数据记录是哪个实体类型的。默认实现是在插入数据时存入实体名称。</p>
<p>-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</p>
<p>接下来，咱们用另一个示例来研究一下如何自定义鉴别器。</p>
<p>先定义一个 Shape 基类。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">abstract</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Shape
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> ShapeID { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>戴上老花镜看清楚，它，是一个抽象类。你没看错，EF Core 是允许向模型添加抽象类的，但随后你必须添加其实现类。毕竟银河系人都知道，抽象类无法生娃……不，是无法实例化。</p>
<p>然后，有几个类派生自 Shape 类。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Rectangle : Shape
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span> Width { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">double</span> Height { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Triangle : Shape
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> A { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> B { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> C { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Circle : Shape
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">float</span> R { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>下面代码定义数据库上下文，实现模型配置。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyContext : DbContext
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnConfiguring(DbContextOptionsBuilder optionsBuilder)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置数据库连接</span>
        SqlConnectionStringBuilder cb = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
        cb.DataSource </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">(localdb)\\mssqllocaldb</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        cb.InitialCatalog </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">testdb</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        cb.IntegratedSecurity </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
        optionsBuilder.UseSqlServer(cb.ConnectionString);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;Shape&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置表名</span>
            ent.ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_shapes</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 继承映射策略（可省略）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            ent.UseTphMappingStrategy();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主键</span>
            ent.HasKey(s =&gt; s.ShapeID).HasName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Shapes</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自定义鉴定器</span>
            ent.<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasDiscriminator&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TypeId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span></strong>
               .HasValue</span>&lt;Shape&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
               .HasValue</span>&lt;Rectangle&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
               .HasValue</span>&lt;Triangle&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
               .HasValue</span>&lt;Circle&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>其他代码你已经很熟了，不用看了，咱们重点关心这里：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>ent.HasDiscriminator&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TypeId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
   .HasValue</span>&lt;Shape&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
   .HasValue</span>&lt;Rectangle&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
   .HasValue</span>&lt;Triangle&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
   .HasValue</span>&lt;Circle&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>);</pre>
</div>
<div>HasDiscriminator 方法用来自定义类型鉴定器，在本示例中，它是 int 类型。名字叫 TypeId，EF Core 会自动帮我们往 Shape 实体添加影子属性（TypeId）。这么一搞，咱们就覆盖了默认的类型标识方法，HasValue 方法用于为各个派生类实体设置鉴别值。</div>
<div>在本示例中，Shape 类的对象我们用1表示，Rectangle 对象我们用 2 表示，Circle 对象用 4 表示。实际上 Shape 类型的标识可能不会出现，我们无法把抽象类的实例添加到数据集合中。</div>
<div>你也看到了，上述代码在配置完 Shape 类后，并没有去添加 Rectangle 等几个派生类。这是因为在自定义类型鉴别器时，HasValue 方法提到了几个派生类，于是，EF Core 就帮我们添加了。</div>
<div>
<p>当然，我们也可以像常规实体一样，配置自定义的属性与列之间的映射。只要注意 ToTable 方法只能在基类 Shape 中配置。简单地说就是：表名、主键都必须在基类中配置。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
    {
        modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;Shape&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置表名</span>
            ent.ToTable(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_shapes</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 继承映射策略（可省略）</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">            ent.UseTphMappingStrategy();
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 属性映射</span>
            <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">ent.Property(s =&gt; s.ShapeID).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">sid</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span></span>            <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 主键</span>
            ent.HasKey(s =&gt; s.ShapeID).HasName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Shapes</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自定义鉴定器</span>
            ent.HasDiscriminator&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TypeId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
               .HasValue</span>&lt;Shape&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
               .HasValue</span>&lt;Rectangle&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
               .HasValue</span>&lt;Triangle&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
               .HasValue</span>&lt;Circle&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
            <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">ent.Property(</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TypeId</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">_type_id</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">);</span>
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;Rectangle&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            ent.Property(s</span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">s.Width)
                .</span>HasColumnName("rect_wid")<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                .HasColumnType(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">decimal</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                .HasPrecision(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>);        <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 精度</span>
            ent.Property(m=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">m.Height)
                .HasColumnName(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">rect_hei</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                .HasColumnType(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">decimal</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                .HasPrecision(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">8</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;Circle&gt;(ce =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            ce.Property(b</span>=&gt;b.R).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">cir_r</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                .HasColumnType(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">decimal</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
                .HasPrecision(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">10</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        });

        modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;Triangle&gt;(ent =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
           ent.Property(a</span>=&gt;a.A).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">a_len</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">); 
           ent.Property(a</span>=&gt;a.B).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">b_len</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">); 
           ent.Property(a</span>=&gt;a.C).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">c_len</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">); 
        });
    }</span></pre>
</div>
<p>然后，创建的数据表如下：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CREATE</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">TABLE</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">tb_shapes</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">sid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 255, 1)">IDENTITY</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">_type_id</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(128, 128, 128, 1)">NOT</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">cir_r</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">decimal</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">10</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">3</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">rect_wid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">decimal</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">8</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">2</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">rect_hei</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">decimal</span>(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">8</span>,<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1); font-weight: bold">2</span>) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">a_len</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">b_len</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">c_len</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">NULL</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">CONSTRAINT</span> <span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Shapes</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">PRIMARY</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">KEY</span> (<span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">[</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">sid</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">]</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
);</span></pre>
</div>
<p>咱们试着每种类型的实体都添加一条记录。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> MyContext())
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取数据集合</span>
    DbSet&lt;Rectangle&gt; rects = context.Set&lt;Rectangle&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
    DbSet</span>&lt;Triangle&gt; triangles = context.Set&lt;Triangle&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
    DbSet</span>&lt;Circle&gt; circles = context.Set&lt;Circle&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加数据</span>
    rects.Add(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Rectangle
    {
        Width </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">120.0d</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        Height </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90.0d</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    });
    circles.Add(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Circle
    {
        R </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">19.2f</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    });
    triangles.Add(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Triangle
    {
        A </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        B </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">14</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
        C </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">22</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    });
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 提交到数据库</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    context.SaveChanges();
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>执行之后，数据库中保存的数据如下图所示。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202605/367389-20260517124829645-658783486.png" alt="image" width="388" height="75" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;由于 EF Core 会将整个继承链作为一个组来管理，所以在获取数据集的时候，可以使用 Shape 类，就像这样。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span>(MyContext context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">())
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 获取兼容性数据集合</span>
    <strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">DbSet&lt;Shape&gt; shapes = context.Set&lt;Shape&gt;</span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">()</span></strong>;
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 添加数据</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    shapes.AddRange(
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Rectangle
        {
            Width </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">120.0d</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            Height </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">90.0d</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        },
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Circle
        {
            R </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">19.2f</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        },
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Triangle
        {
            A </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">16</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            B </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">14</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
            C </span>= <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">22</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        });
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 提交数据库</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    context.SaveChanges();
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>你可以向 shapes 集合添加 Rectangle、Circle 或 Triangle 类。这是利用了派生类实例可以给基类赋值的特点。</p>
<p>----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------</p>
<p>TPH 有两种特殊的列映射。先说第一种：来自不同派生类的属性映射到同一列。大前提是属性的数据类型要一样，这个好理解，如果两个类中的属性，一个是 string，另一个是 double，这映射到同一列，那数据库中这个列要用什么类型？显然是不行的（除非你写了值转器，并且保证数据库中存入这个列的内容可兼容）。</p>
<p>下面是个常规例子，一个抽象基类，两个同级派生类。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">abstract</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DevBoard
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> BoardID { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PicoBaord : DevBoard
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> UartNum { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BeeBoard : DevBoard
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> I2sNum { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>这里咱们要做一个特殊处理，就是把 PicoBoard的 UartNum 和 BeeBoard 类的 I2sNum 属性都映射到 bus_num 列。两个属性都是 int 类型，可以共享其数据。</p>
<p>下面是模型配置。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
{
    modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;DevBoard&gt;(bde =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        bde.ToTable(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">tb_boards</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        bde.HasKey(b </span>=&gt; b.BoardID).HasName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">PK_Boards</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置鉴别器</span>
        bde.HasDiscriminator&lt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span>&gt;(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">EntityType</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
         .<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><strong>HasValue</strong></span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><strong>&lt;PicoBaord&gt;("PICO"</strong></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1); color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><strong>)</strong></span>
         .<span style="color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">HasValue</span></strong></span></span><span style="color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">&lt;BeeBoard&gt;("BEE"</span></strong></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(255, 255, 255, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">)</span></strong></span>;
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 配置属性</span>
        bde.Property(a =&gt; a.BoardID).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bid</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        bde.Property(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">EntityType</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>).HasColumnName(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">__type</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
            .HasMaxLength(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">5</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    });
    modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;PicoBaord&gt;(pb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
       pb.Property(s</span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">s.UartNum)
            .<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasColumnName(</span></strong></span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bus_num</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span></strong>; 
    });
    modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;BeeBoard&gt;(bet =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
       bet.Property(a</span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">a.I2sNum)
            .<strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasColumnName(</span></strong></span><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bus_num</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span></strong><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><strong><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span></strong>; 
    });
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>在这个例子中，老周使用字符串“PICO”、“BEE”来区分两个类实体。</p>
<p>接下来，咱们为这两个类分别存入两条数据。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span> MyContext context = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
context.Database.EnsureCreated();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 每个类各添加两条记录</span>
DbSet&lt;DevBoard&gt; boards = context.Set&lt;DevBoard&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
boards.AddRange(
    </span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> PicoBaord{ UartNum = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> }</span>,
    </span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> PicoBaord{ UartNum = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> }</span>);
boards.AddRange(
    </span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> BeeBoard{ I2sNum = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> }</span>,
    </span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> BeeBoard{ I2sNum = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"> }</span>
);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 提交数据库</span>
context.SaveChanges();</pre>
</div>
<p>最后，数据库中的内容如下图所示。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202605/367389-20260517165109989-718391384.png" alt="image" width="183" height="93" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<p>第二种情况就是：派生类之间有名称相同的属性，且映射的列名不同。这个不要求数据类型相同，因为它们没任何联系，仅仅名字相同罢了，属于不共享状态。</p>
<p>咱们把上面例子的实体类改一下，让每个派生类都有 UartNum 和 I2cNum 属性。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">abstract</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> DevBoard
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> BoardID { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> PicoBaord : DevBoard
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">UartNum</span> { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">I2cNum</span>{<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;}
}

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> BeeBoard : DevBoard
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">UartNum</span> { <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>; <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">; }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">int</span> <span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">I2cNum</span>{<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">get</span>;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">set</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;}
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>但配置时注意，它们将映射到不同的列。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> OnModelCreating(ModelBuilder modelBuilder)
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 这部分不变</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">    ……

    modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;PicoBaord&gt;(pb =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        pb.Property(s </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> s.UartNum)
            .<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasColumnName(</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pico_uart_num</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span>;
        pb.Property(k </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> k.I2cNum)
            .<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasColumnName(</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">pico_i2c_num</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span>;
    });
    modelBuilder.Entity</span>&lt;BeeBoard&gt;(bet =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        bet.Property(a </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> a.UartNum)
            .<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasColumnName(</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bee_uart_num</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span>;
        bet.Property(f </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> f.I2cNum)
            .<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">HasColumnName(</span></span><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">bee_i2c_num</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span></span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 0, 1)">)</span>;
    });
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p>同样地，咱们也分别添加两条数据。</p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre>DbSet&lt;DevBoard&gt; boards = context.Set&lt;DevBoard&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();
boards.AddRange(
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> PicoBaord{ UartNum = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span>, I2cNum = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> PicoBaord{ UartNum = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">1</span>, I2cNum = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> });
boards.AddRange(
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> BeeBoard{ UartNum = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">4</span>, I2cNum = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">2</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> },
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> BeeBoard{ UartNum = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span>, I2cNum = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">3</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> }
);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 提交数据库</span>
context.SaveChanges();</pre>
</div>
<p>数据库中的数据如下图所示。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/367389/202605/367389-20260517170627119-836488072.png" alt="image" width="400" height="82" loading="lazy"></p>
<p>好了，今天的水文就水到这里了。&nbsp;</p>
